doc.name: Campus Survey Demo
doc.description: This is a demonstration module create for FAIMS3 focus groups held in April and May 2022.

component-parameters.label: Take GPS Starting Point
component-parameters.name: take-gps-starting-point
component-parameters.helperText: Tap to select the starting point for the survey.

component-parameters.label: Campus Zone
component-parameters.name: campus-zone
component-parameters.helperText: Select your campus area from the list. (For other, use annotation icon)

component-parameters.label: Survey Note
component-parameters.name: survey-note
component-parameters.helperText: Note comments about survey area here

component-parameters.label: Take GPS End Point
component-parameters.name: take-gps-end-point
component-parameters.helperText: Tap to select the end point for the survey.

component-parameters.label: Element ID
component-parameters.name: hridFORM2
component-parameters.helperText: This is unique ID for each landscape element composed from an auto-incrementer and the element type.

component-parameters.label: Element Type
component-parameters.name: element-type
component-parameters.helperText: Select the type of landscape element that you see, e.g. bench seat, street lamp etc. Fill other in annotation.

component-parameters.label: Asset number
component-parameters.name: asset-number
component-parameters.helperText: Enter the asset number of the item, if known. In annotation, note difficulties.

component-parameters.label: Condition
component-parameters.name: condition
component-parameters.helperText: Select an option for the overall condition of the landscape element. Add notes, if needed, in annotation.

component-parameters.label: Element Notes
component-parameters.name: element-notes
component-parameters.helperText: Add additional description or observations as needed.

component-parameters.label: Nearest building
component-parameters.name: nearest-building
component-parameters.helperText: Make a note of the nearest identifiable building. Check uncertain in the field annotation if uncertain.

component-parameters.label: Survey Area ID
component-parameters.name: hridFORM1
component-parameters.helperText: A read-only field composited from campus-zone and nickname to make a custom ID.

component-parameters.label: Landscape Elements
component-parameters.name: landscape-elements
component-parameters.helperText: Associate/record new street furniture with this survey area

component-parameters.label: Survey Area Nickname
component-parameters.name: survey-area-nickname
component-parameters.helperText: Give a memorable name to your survey area.

component-parameters.label: Safety Hazard
component-parameters.name: checkbox
component-parameters.helperText: Selecting this box will alert maintenance (eventually)

component-parameters.label: Draw bounding box around survey area
component-parameters.name: draw-bounding-box-around-survey-area

component-parameters.label: Related Survey Area
component-parameters.name: related-survey-area
component-parameters.helperText: Select or Add new related survey area

FORM1SECTION1.description: Here you will describe the survey session.
